rationale: C02 plausibly supplied a material template because it uses the same section 22 mechanism and a closely parallel drafting sequence: statutory authority, Tariff Commission investigation and report, a finding concerning interference with a Department of Agriculture program, and an operative restriction on articles “entered, or withdrawn from warehouse, for consumption” during a specified period. C17 and C09 share much of the same machinery, but are more clearly iterations of the specialized supplemental-cotton-quota form. C02 is the strongest displayed bridge to the child's new section 22 import restriction.

shared_material.child_excerpt: pursuant to section 22 of the Agricultural Adjustment Act ... I caused the United States Tariff Commission to make an investigation
shared_material.parent_excerpt: pursuant to the said section 22 ... the United States Tariff Commission has made a supplemental investigation
shared_material.explanation: Both ground the proclamation in a Tariff Commission investigation conducted under the same statutory provision.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the Commission has made such investigation ... and has reported to me its findings and recommendations
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the Commission has made findings of fact and has transmitted to me a report of such findings and its recommendations based thereon
shared_material.explanation: The same investigation-report-recommendation stage precedes presidential action.

shared_material.child_excerpt: render or tend to render ineffective, or materially interfere with, a program undertaken by the Department of Agriculture
shared_material.parent_excerpt: render ineffective or materially interfere with the program undertaken with respect to cotton
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive section 22 interference language supplies the central required presidential finding.

shared_material.child_excerpt: entered, or withdrawn from warehouse, for consumption during the period ... in excess of an aggregate quantity
shared_material.parent_excerpt: entry for consumption, or withdrawal from warehouse for consumption, during the quota year ... of 1,500,000 pounds
shared_material.explanation: The operative provisions use materially parallel customs-entry machinery, a fixed period, and a quantitative threshold.
